integrity: Proof reproduced from exact normalized monomial and beta-binomial formulas; finite checker is supplementary and not a proof of the infinite asymptotic. Publication priority remains subject to expert comparison with possible general nonsmooth-symbol results.
scientific_limitations: Fixed weighted Bergman exponent alpha>-1, fixed cone proportion 0<t<1, two-complex-dimensional unit ball, coordinate z_1 commutator. No general discontinuous-symbol theorem, endpoint-uniform asymptotics, or independent mathematical validation claimed.
title: A sharp cubic singular-value law for angular-cone Bergman commutators
